errors.text: The proposed Mo alloying intervention does not reconstruct the processing and silicide-coating strategy underlying the target.
Neither cited source provides evidence that Mo addition forms a stable, dense, protective oxide on equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr.
The hypothesis does not specify the Mo concentration, so the intervention cannot be reproduced or compositionally interpreted.
The experiment does not test whether room-temperature ductility and high-temperature strength are preserved, despite this being an explicit design constraint.
The asserted protective-oxide mechanism ignores the potential volatility and nonprotective behavior of molybdenum oxides at elevated temperature.
